name: Burning Cascade cuts Dawnsear and Sunflare's cast time and mana cost by 10%/20% per rank (#1343)
contract: Burning Cascade rank 1 (560859) and rank 2 (561329) are family 33, Attributes 448 (SPELL_ATTR0_PASSIVE), EquippedItemClass -1, no Stances, so each self-applies on learn. Both ranks carry two SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) effects on the same EffectSpellClassMask word1 1282 (bits 0x2, 0x100 and 0x400): effect 0 has EffectMiscValue 10 (SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME), effect 1 has EffectMiscValue 14 (SPELLMOD_COST); rank 1's EffectBasePoints are -11 + DieSides 1 = -10 on both, rank 2's are -21 + DieSides 1 = -20 on both. Dawnsear (500146 and its ranks 502366-502371) carries word1 bit 0x2; Sunflare (800231 and ranks 502386-502397) carries word1 bit 0x100. SpellInfo::CalcCastTime and SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost both apply ApplySpellMod unconditionally; this is not "no server-side implementation", both named spells already get the cast-time and mana-cost reduction at both ranks. (Word1 bit 0x400 also matches an unrelated spell, 'Glorious Execution Mana Passive' 807451; that stray match is not part of this issue and is recorded separately, not fixed here.)
